text: dsh-agent-attribution 是一款面向 DSH 的提示词插件：它在系统提示词中加入 Git 提交和 Pull Request 署名指引，并依据智能体当前使用的模型生成署名中的模型名称。插件通过配置自定义提交与 PR 模板、邮箱和模型名称映射，也可分别关闭某类署名；模型名可取自实时选择、配置映射、提供商目录或模型 ID 的可读化结果。适合希望智能体为其创建的提交和 PR 添加一致署名的 DSH 用户。代码未读取密钥或调用外部服务；可在配置中设置署名文本。

dsh-agent-attribution adds commit and pull request attribution guidance to the DSH system prompt, using the active model name. Configure templates, an email, and model-name mappings, or omit either line. It suits users seeking consistent attribution on commits and pull requests created by agents.
想让 DSH 智能体在提交说明里自动带上当前模型的署名。
能不能让智能体创建 PR 时附上包含模型名称的说明？
I want generated commits and pull requests to include attribution for the model that created them.
dsh-agent-attribution 的功能「提交与 PR 署名提示」：它将署名要求加入系统提示词，并按当前模型生成提交和 PR 署名。可配置模板、邮箱及模型名映射，也可关闭单项署名。

dsh-agent-attribution README · dsh-agent-attribution：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that tells agents how to attribute the git commits and pull requests they create. It is modelled on Claude Code's `attribution` setting, with the model name filled in automatically.

With the defaults, agents are instructed to:

- end commit messages with a blank line and then `Co-Authored-By: <model> <noreply@deepseek.com>`
- end pull request descriptions with `Generated with DeepSeek Harness (<model>)`

dsh-agent-attribution README · dsh-agent-attribution：The instruction is added as an `Attribution` section of the system prompt. It says that the user's own instructions about these lines (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, memory rules) take precedence, and that agents must not add attribution lines the section does not list. It is sent whether or not the working directory is a git repository, as in Claude Code.

dsh-agent-attribution README · Installation：Link the package into your profile with `plugin_manager` (`install_bundle`, target = the absolute path of this directory), or from the command line, then restart or reload the profile. To turn the instruction off, disable the plugin.

dsh-agent-attribution README · Configuration：The plugin row is `agent-attribution` in `cordis.patch.yml`. Override its `config` in your profile patch:

```yaml
- id: agent-attribution
  config:
    pr: ''
    commit: 'Co-Authored-By: {model} <{email}>'

dsh-agent-attribution README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `commit` | `Co-Authored-By: {model} <{email}>` | Commit attribution. Omit for the default, `''` to drop the line, or any text (multi-line is kept verbatim). |
| `pr` | `Generated with DeepSeek Harness ({model})` | Pull request attribution. Same rules as `commit`. |
| `email` | `noreply@deepseek.com` | Value of the `{email}` placeholder. |
| `modelNames` | `{}` | Display-name overrides keyed by model id (exact match, then longest prefix). |

dsh-agent-attribution README · Configuration：Placeholders in `commit` and `pr`: `{model}` (display name), `{modelId}` and `{email}`.

If both `commit` and `pr` are `''`, the section is omitted entirely, which is what Claude Code does too. Claude Code's `sessionUrl` is not implemented.

dsh-agent-attribution README · How the model name is chosen：1. The model the agent is actually running, which is the live model selection. This can differ from the model the agent was created with. The plugin reads the final `provider` and `model` prompt variables for this reason.
2. A `modelNames` entry from this plugin's config.
3. The `name` the provider's model catalog gives that model (for example `Claude Sonnet 5.5` from your profile's `llm-pi-ai` config).
4. The model id made readable: `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017[1m]` becomes `DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017`, and `claude-opus-5-5` becomes `Claude Opus 5.5`.
5. `DeepSeek Harness` when no model is known.
section: How the model name is chosen

text: dsh-agent-attribution README · How the model name is chosen：Subagents get their own model name. Changing the model mid-session changes the trailer, and the system-prompt prefix with it, so expect a prompt-cache miss at that point.

dsh-agent-attribution README · Files：- `index.js`: the Host plugin (`Config`, section registration, assembly listener).
- `attribution.js`: pure text and model-name helpers, free of Host imports.
- `cordis.patch.yml`, `package.json`, `locale/`, `icon.svg`: bundle manifest and display metadata.

dsh-agent-attribution README · Related：`dsh-skill-badge` is a separate, optional dsh plugin that adds a "powered by dsh" badge to pull requests. If you enable it, you may want `pr: ''` here so the two do not overlap.
